trickyParts: The lock record now holds the holder's PID namespace (readlink /proc/self/ns/pid); its pid is trusted only in the same namespace, so a holder in another role's namespace is reported as not visible rather than as gone.
The 5 s sampler's failed reads are counted per in-window sample and kept out of every statistic, so a column with no successful read renders '-'.
deviations: meta.json keeps the redacted argument list ('<redacted>' in place of each token value) rather than naming a token file: loadgen takes tokens as flag values, not files.
